title: Lunatic Asylums
subtitle: Test your understanding of Lunatic Asylums — the five-thousand-bed loosh battery, the catatonic store, and the decades before the clones matured.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: A five-thousand-bed ward, a sign that says Care, and decades of silence while a new population grows underground. The people in those beds had seen the reset. The compound kept them alive long enough to be drained.

questions.question: What was the primary operational purpose of lunatic asylums following a planetary reset?

options.label: A
options.text: Serving as the underground halls where cloned replacement infants are incubated.
options.rationale: Cloned infants are incubated in underground facilities, while the asylums hold adult survivors.

options.label: B
options.text: Operating as proto-FEMA shelters that hold external liberators off the stripped landscape.
options.rationale: The compounds contain shell-shocked survivors for extraction, and the liberators are the ones who would exploit a starvation gap.

options.label: C
options.text: Functioning as high-capacity loosh power stations to harvest negative energy from traumatized survivors.
options.rationale: The facilities are power stations rather than medical institutions, built to drain traumatized survivors.

options.label: D
options.text: Providing compassionate care and medical reform for survivors of the harvest.
options.rationale: Care is the sign on the door, and the work inside maintains trauma instead of treating it.

questions.hint: Look at what the compounds supplied while the surface herd was gone.

questions.question: How did the occupying hierarchy acquire the grand architectural structures used for lunatic asylums?

options.label: A
options.text: They inherited monumental edifices built by the advanced, harmonious civilization existing prior to the reset.
options.rationale: These grand edifices were inherited from the harmonious civilization that existed prior to the reset.

options.label: B
options.text: They had compliant caretakers from the shielded zones raise five-thousand-bed compounds during the demographic gap.
options.rationale: Caretakers were stored in shielded zones to guide cloned orphans, not to erect the asylum buildings.

options.label: C
options.text: They excavated ancient subterranean vaults after the cataclysm and raised them beside the empty Tartarian cities as new containment wards.
options.rationale: The buildings were already standing on the surface and were repurposed, not lifted out of the ground.

options.label: D
options.text: They constructed the compounds from standardized plans in the weeks after surface hostility ceased.
options.rationale: The post-reset society did not design or construct these edifices for the mentally ill.

questions.hint: Look at who built the monumental buildings before the cataclysm.

questions.question: Within the energetic economy of the occupying hierarchy, how is loosh defined?

options.label: A
options.text: Electromagnetic current gathered by the lunar satellite to run the rail networks and the orphan trains between cleared cities.
options.rationale: The lunar satellite projects low-frequency waves and gathers loosh, and it does not power the orphan trains.

options.label: B
options.text: Cellular material taken from surface survivors before execution and incubated as replacement infants.
options.rationale: Cellular material is extracted for cloning, while loosh is the energetic emission of suffering.

options.label: C
options.text: Dense, low-frequency emotional and spiritual emissions generated through terror, degradation, and torture.
options.rationale: Loosh is the emotional and spiritual energetic emissions that nourish parasitic entities and demons.

options.label: D
options.text: High-frequency output from the bells and nodal generators cleared out of Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: Those bells and generators are the old-world technologies that were stripped away, not the metabolic feed of the demons.

questions.hint: Look at the emission produced by terror, degradation, and torture.

questions.question: What created the severe energetic supply disruption for demonic entities immediately after a reset?

options.label: A
options.text: The complete eradication of the surface civilian and child population during the harvest.
options.rationale: The child population is fully harvested for energetic and biochemical consumption, leaving a supply break.

options.label: B
options.text: An intervention by benevolent soul family extraterrestrials that shut the lunar satellite and tore the suppressive density overlays.
options.rationale: The asylums exist so that starvation never becomes the signal that would bring those liberators in.

options.label: C
options.text: A failure of the underground incubation chambers holding the cloned replacement infants.
options.rationale: The chambers proceed as planned, and the gap is the decades before those infants mature.

options.label: D
options.text: The destruction of the lunar satellite during the open slaughter on the surface.
options.rationale: The lunar satellite stays in the firmament as a transmission hub and loosh gathering station.

questions.hint: Look at what the harvest does to the people still on the surface.

questions.question: What key role did the catatonic store of asylum inmates play in maintaining realm stability?

options.label: A
options.text: It sent high-frequency nodal vibrations out to close tears in the containment field.
options.rationale: The wards hold chronic low-frequency distress, and the high-frequency generators were cleared from the cities.

options.label: B
options.text: It trained shell-shocked adults into compliant caretakers who would meet the orphan trains in the cleared Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: Caretakers were pre-selected people stored in shielded zones, not the inmates being drained.

options.label: C
options.text: It preserved old-world free-energy architecture inside the inmates for later urban repair.
options.rationale: Old-world memory was targeted for elimination, and the inmates were kept as an energetic reserve.

options.label: D
options.text: It provided a continuous energetic reserve during the 20 to 30 year void while replacement clones matured.
options.rationale: The inmates bridge the years until cloned infants reach reproductive and harvestable maturity.

questions.hint: Look at how the parasites crossed the multi-decade demographic gap.

questions.question: What was the true cause of the catatonic state observed in post-reset asylum inmates?

options.label: A
options.text: Acute shell shock from directly witnessing the graphic annihilation and flaying of their families.
options.rationale: Shell shock is the catatonic trauma state induced by open slaughter, flaying, and mass cannibalism.

options.label: B
options.text: Organic brain degeneration caused by toxins left on the stripped landscape after the cataclysm.
options.rationale: The inmates were not biologically defective, and the state follows what they witnessed.

options.label: C
options.text: Targeted waves from the bells that once stood in the harmonious cities.
options.rationale: Those bells belonged to the prior civilization, and the catatonia comes from witnessing the atrocities.

options.label: D
options.text: Neurological damage left by the underground cloning procedures used on surface survivors.
options.rationale: The inmates are original surface survivors, and the cloning is done to cellular material taken before execution.

questions.hint: Look at what the survivors witnessed while the harvest was still underway.

questions.question: How long was the temporal gap required for cloned replacement infants to reach maturity?

options.label: A
options.text: Fifty to sixty years inside the shielded zones.
options.rationale: The void the catatonic store is built to cover is twenty to thirty years.

options.label: B
options.text: Five to ten years after the orphan trains arrive.
options.rationale: The report places maturity at roughly twenty to thirty years, not a single short decade.

options.label: C
options.text: Twenty to thirty years.
options.rationale: Cloned infants need that span before they reach reproductive and harvestable maturity.

options.label: D
options.text: One hundred years before the catatonic store is opened.
options.rationale: The asylums ration the survivors across the twenty-to-thirty-year gap, not a century.

questions.hint: Look at the demographic gap before the clones become harvestable.

questions.question: What is the technological origin of the term lunatic?

options.label: A
options.text: High-frequency nodal generators inherited from the harmonious civilization before the reset.
options.rationale: Those generators were stripped from the cities, and the designation comes from the lunar waves.

options.label: B
options.text: Subterranean vaults where cellular material waited before the cloned infants were incubated.
options.rationale: Those vaults belong to the cloning pipeline, not to the origin of the designation.

options.label: C
options.text: Rotational generators under the five-thousand-bed wards, built to turn chronic distress into a stored current for local governance.
options.rationale: The wards drain people directly, and the word is tied to the lunar satellite.

options.label: D
options.text: The lunar satellite in the firmament projecting low-frequency waves to agitate human neurochemistry.
options.rationale: That hub was built to deliberately agitate human neurochemistry during specific phases.

questions.hint: Look at the transmission hub tied to the word.

questions.question: What institutional facade was painted over asylum entrances to mask their predatory function?

options.label: A
options.text: Academies that instructed cloned orphans brought in on the rail networks.
options.rationale: Orphans go to caretakers in the cleared cities, and the asylum door says Care.

options.label: B
options.text: Quarantine outposts that screened wandering survivors for contagion before they entered the Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: The public pretext is compassionate care and medical reform, not a contagion screen.

options.label: C
options.text: Humanitarian care and medical benevolence for the destitute and mentally infirm.
options.rationale: The institutional facade displayed on the doors is Care, covering degradation and experimentation.

options.label: D
options.text: Research halls for the atmospheric energy technologies stripped from the cities.
options.rationale: Those technologies were cleared away, and the mask on the asylum is humanitarian benevolence.

questions.hint: Look at the public story placed over the entrance.

questions.question: Which global event was engineered specifically to eliminate wandering surface survivors who escaped asylum containment?

options.label: A
options.text: The spread of industrial labor through the repopulated urban centers.
options.rationale: The elimination of the age group that still remembered the old world is tied to the war.

options.label: B
options.text: World War I.
options.rationale: Survivors who escaped institutionalization were targeted for systemic elimination in that war.

options.label: C
options.text: The orphan train network that carried cloned children into cleared cities.
options.rationale: The trains bring replacement children in, and the war slaughters the adults who escaped the asylums.

options.label: D
options.text: The cleansing of atmospheric energy technologies from the Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: That cleansing stripped bells and nodal generators, while the war targeted the wandering people.

questions.hint: Look at the conflict used against survivors who stayed outside the compounds.

questions.question: What specific human demographic was targeted for elimination during World War I?

options.label: A
options.text: Pre-selected caretakers who leaked cloning methods to the surface communities.
options.rationale: Caretakers stay compliant in shielded zones and later guide the cloned orphans.

options.label: B
options.text: Surviving individuals aged sixteen to their mid-fifties who retained memory of the old world.
options.rationale: That war was aimed at people in their fifties who possessed lingering memories of the prior world.

options.label: C
options.text: Top-tier sold souls who lost administrative control over the local populations.
options.rationale: Sold souls administer the realm under demonic hosts, and the war targets the remembering survivors.

options.label: D
options.text: Cloned infants who showed defects before they left the underground facilities.
options.rationale: The war slaughters surface survivors aged sixteen to their mid-fifties, not the incubated infants.

questions.hint: Look at the age group that still carried old-world memory.

questions.question: Why did energetic starvation within the demonic hierarchy pose an existential risk to realm containment?

options.label: A
options.text: It cut power to the underground chambers where replacement infants were incubated.
options.rationale: The danger is a tear in the density overlays that monitoring liberators could see.

options.label: B
options.text: It let sold souls recover an innate spiritual power and turn the command structure against the demonic hosts.
options.rationale: Sold souls possess zero innate power and remain reliant on the entities that host them.

options.label: C
options.text: It created a detectable energetic vacuum that would prompt benevolent soul family extraterrestrials to intervene.
options.rationale: That energetic vacuum would have exposed the weakness and brought intervention through the containment field.

options.label: D
options.text: It shut down the lunar satellite that agitates human neurochemistry from the firmament.
options.rationale: The satellite is a standing transmission hub, and the risk named here is starvation of the demons.

questions.hint: Look at who is watching for a tear in the suppressive overlay.

questions.question: How were cloned replacement infants transported into cleared urban environments?

options.label: A
options.text: By release from the five-thousand-bed wards that held the catatonic store.
options.rationale: Those wards hold shell-shocked adults, and the children move on rail networks.

options.label: B
options.text: Along underground channels running from the incubation chambers into the Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: Incubation is underground, and the move into the cities is on rail networks.

options.label: C
options.text: Through firmament nodes that projected the cloned children into the cleared cities.
options.rationale: The nodes that remain are for waves and loosh, and the children travel by rail.

options.label: D
options.text: Through orphan train rail networks.
options.rationale: The replacement children are the cloned orphans transported into the cities.

questions.hint: Look at how the cloned children reached the cleared cities.

questions.question: What old-world features were systematically stripped from Tartarian cities before repopulation?

options.label: A
options.text: Subterranean cloning tanks and the cellular collection lines that fed the underground incubation chambers.
options.rationale: Cloning stays in the underground facilities, and the cities lose their atmospheric technologies.

options.label: B
options.text: Atmospheric energy technologies, bells, and high-frequency nodal generators.
options.rationale: The empty Tartarian cities were systematically cleared of those old-world features before the orphans arrived.

options.label: C
options.text: The lunar satellite and its low-frequency transmission hub.
options.rationale: The lunar satellite remains the transmission hub, and the cities lose bells and nodal generators.

options.label: D
options.text: The five-thousand-bed asylum wards repurposed after the cataclysm.
options.rationale: Those wards are kept and used as the catatonic store, not stripped out.

questions.hint: Look at what was cleared from the cities while the adults were being drained.

questions.question: What is the primary characteristic of sold souls within the post-reset administrative lattice?

options.label: A
options.text: They are shell-shocked survivors who escaped the asylums and kept old-world memory.
options.rationale: Those survivors are hunted in the war, and sold souls are the hosted administrators.

options.label: B
options.text: They are benevolent soul family extraterrestrials who monitor the realm from outside and wait for a tear in the suppressive density overlays.
options.rationale: That monitoring family is the liberating side, and sold souls are the hosted human administrators.

options.label: C
options.text: They are human leaders whose own spiritual energy lets them govern without a demonic host.
options.rationale: The report says they possess zero innate power and rely on the demonic entities.

options.label: D
options.text: They are top-tier human administrators possessing no innate power, entirely dependent on hosted demonic entities.
options.rationale: These are the demonic entities that host and direct the administrators who possess zero innate power.

questions.hint: Look at what human leaders can do without a demonic host.

questions.question: How did routine operational procedures inside asylums affect the energetic state of inmates?

options.label: A
options.text: They wiped memory so shell-shocked adults could be sent out as caretakers.
options.rationale: Inmates are rationed and harvested over decades, not retrained as caretakers.

options.label: B
options.text: They raised brief high-frequency states so inmates would match the lunar satellite.
options.rationale: The procedures keep chronic distress, and experimental procedures prevent energetic recovery.

options.label: C
options.text: They eased trauma so inmates could rejoin the cities once the clones matured.
options.rationale: The facilities are living slaughterhouses, and trauma is intensified rather than healed.

options.label: D
options.text: They actively maintained, stimulated, and intensified ongoing trauma to ensure continuous low-frequency output.
options.rationale: The existing trauma was actively maintained so the wards would not stabilize.

questions.hint: Look at whether the procedures eased trauma or kept it going.

questions.question: What standard capacity was designed into the repurposed institutional power stations?

options.label: A
options.text: Ten thousand beds on every subterranean tier.
options.rationale: The figure given for these surface compounds is upwards of five thousand beds.

options.label: B
options.text: Upwards of five thousand beds.
options.rationale: The compounds are industrial scale containment facilities holding five thousand or more beds.

options.label: C
options.text: A few hundred beds in each city ward.
options.rationale: A ward of a few hundred would not be the five-thousand-bed power station described.

options.label: D
options.text: Fifty thousand beds in each Tartarian city.
options.rationale: Individual compounds are scaled to five thousand or more beds, not fifty thousand.

questions.hint: Look at the scale of each repurposed containment compound.

questions.question: What immediate consequence occurs to demonic entities if their continuous loosh supply is completely severed?

options.label: A
options.text: Their hosts pull high-frequency nodal energy from the lunar satellite and from the bells cleared out of the Tartarian cities.
options.rationale: Demonic vitality rapidly degrades without loosh, and the bells are not a substitute feed.

options.label: B
options.text: Their functional vitality rapidly degrades, causing systemic paralysis across the command structure.
options.rationale: Without the feed, the result is systemic paralysis across their entire command structure.

options.label: C
options.text: Their hosts start another reset while the asylum wards are still full.
options.rationale: The stated result of a severed feed is loss of functional vitality and paralysis of command.

options.label: D
options.text: Their hosts drop into cloned bodies waiting inside the underground incubation chambers.
options.rationale: The entities host sold souls, and starvation degrades their vitality instead of moving them into clones.

questions.hint: Look at what happens to demonic vitality when the feed stops.

questions.question: Where were pre-selected, compliant caretakers housed prior to guiding cloned orphans in urban centers?

options.label: A
options.text: Inside the asylum wards beside the shell-shocked adult survivors.
options.rationale: The wards hold the catatonic store, and the caretakers are kept in shielded zones.

options.label: B
options.text: Within shielded zones protected during the reset cleansing.
options.rationale: They are the pre selected compliant caretakers stored for the repopulation of the cities.

options.label: C
options.text: Within firmament stations run by the benevolent soul family.
options.rationale: The soul family monitors from outside, and the caretakers are stored in shielded zones.

options.label: D
options.text: Inside the incubation tanks beside the cloned replacement infants.
options.rationale: The tanks hold the infants, and the caretakers are stored in shielded zones.

questions.hint: Look at where the caretakers were kept while the cities were being cleared.

questions.question: Which specific old-world knowledge possessed by wandering survivors posed a direct threat to the matrix lattice?

options.label: A
options.text: Operating manuals for the underground incubation chambers and cloning tanks.
options.rationale: Cloning is run by the occupying forces, and the dangerous memory is the old-world plane, healing, and free energy.

options.label: B
options.text: Knowledge of the true flat plane, natural healing modalities, and free-energy architecture.
options.rationale: The survivors still knew the true flat plane and the natural healing modalities of the old world.

options.label: C
options.text: Construction plans for the lunar transmission hub in the firmament.
options.rationale: The lunar hub belongs to the parasitic system, and the threat is memory of the true flat plane.

options.label: D
options.text: Spoken codes for reaching the benevolent soul family outside the realm.
options.rationale: The soul family responds to an energetic vacuum, not to codes carried by wandering survivors.

questions.hint: Look at the memories the war was meant to erase.

questions.question: What role did medical experimentation play within the 5,000-bed loosh power stations?

options.label: A
options.text: Measuring how inmates responded to the bells after the cities were cleared.
options.rationale: The bells were stripped from the cities, and the experiments serve agony and despair.

options.label: B
options.text: Building biological protection for the cloned infants before they boarded the orphan trains.
options.rationale: The procedures are pretexts to induce agony and despair in the inmates, not care for the clones.

options.label: C
options.text: Inducing intense physical agony and spiritual despair to maximize loosh extraction.
options.rationale: The wards become living slaughterhouses where victims were worn down and killed.

options.label: D
options.text: Restoring pre-reset memory so catatonic survivors could be marched to slaughter.
options.rationale: Existing trauma is intensified, and memory of the old world is what the wider cleansing tries to erase.

questions.hint: Look at what the clinical procedures were actually for.

questions.question: True or False: Monumental architectural edifices were repurposed into containment facilities within days or weeks of the cataclysm concluding.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The grand architectural structures were rapidly repurposed into high-security containment centers.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report places that conversion within days or weeks of the cataclysm concluding.

questions.hint: Look at the pace of the repurposing once surface hostility ended.

questions.question: True or False: The asylum network hid an acute structural vulnerability to energetic starvation from the benevolent soul family.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The network was deployed so the hierarchy could maintain continuous survival across reset cycles.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Starvation during that drought would have exposed the weakness to the monitoring soul family.

questions.hint: Look at what the compounds were built to hide during the demographic drought.

questions.question: True or False: Lunatic asylums were built by the post-reset society as genuine treatment centers for the mentally infirm.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The buildings were inherited, and the interior was predatory rather than a treatment program.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: They come from the harmonious civilization that existed prior to the reset, then were turned into containment centers.

questions.hint: Look at who first built the monumental buildings and what the entrance concealed.

questions.question: True or False: Cellular material was taken from surface survivors before execution so cloned replacement infants could be incubated underground.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The occupying forces use that material to incubate cloned replacement infants for the emptied cities.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report ties the extraction to underground incubation of the replacement generation.

questions.hint: Look at how the workforce was restarted after the harvest.
